name: PLTD transfer logic flaw
summary: PLTD's transfer() deducts from the liquidity pair's balance on every transfer to it without calling sync(), so the attacker shrank the PLTD reserve and swapped out the pair's USDT at an inflated rate.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
